WITH d AS (
 SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) nl, count(DISTINCT closing_units) nu, count(DISTINCT closing_value) nv
 FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22' GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) keys, sum(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dup_keys, max(n) maxn, sum(CASE WHEN n>1 AND nu=1 AND nv=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) identical_vals, sum(CASE WHEN n>1 AND nl>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diff_load
FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT fs.week_ending_date, s.store_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT fs.product_key) np, sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units IS NULL OR fs.closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nul, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zz, sum(fs.closing_value) val
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND s.region='West'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week
  WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT cp.category, f.week_ending_date, p.category AS cat_was, SUM(f.closing_value) AS wk_value
  FROM dedup f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT category, count(DISTINCT week_ending_date) weeks, ROUND(SUM(wk_value)/4,2) avg_asis, sum(CASE WHEN category<>cat_was THEN wk_value ELSE 0 END)/4 moved
FROM weekly GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
